t: Im haroq ume raglayim vedomayv machmitzin
s: Im haroq ume raglayim vedomayv machmitzin ubo t"z seipim: kebar nitbaer besiman ts"b sheen mebi et haddagan o et haqqemach lide chimmutz ella mayim o toledot mayim. Veellu hen toledot hammayim: hayyotze min haayin, min haozen, min hachotem, min happeh, ben shel adam ben shel behema chayya vaop, ume raglayim shel adam, ben qetannim ben gedolim, dehaynu mashqin hayyotzein mippi hattabbaat. Abal hatztzoa, ben shel adam ben shel behema chayya vaop, ume raglayim shel behema chayya vaop, vezeat adam (abal shel behema nitbaer besiman tn"g), vehechalab, vehashshumman, vehacheleb, ume hammara — dinam keme perot sheen machmitzin. Ella im ken nitareb bahem mayim kol shehu, veaz hen memaharin lehachmitz yoter mimmayim bilbad. Lepikak, im napelu letok haissa shennillosha bemayim — tzarik leepotah miyyad, kemo shennitbaer besiman ts"b. Abal im napelu al haqqemach venitlachleach haqqemach mehem veachar kak nitnaggeb — muttar lalush otah bemayim, veen tzarik leepotah miyyad (achar gemar hallisha), dekevan shekkebar nitnaggebu venibleu betok haqqemach qodem shebbau alayv mayim — shub en bahem koach lemaher hachimmutz kesheyyabou alayv mayim:

Hattal dino kemayim. Vehaddam dino keme perot. Veim napal letoko dagan velo shaha betoko meet leet, ap al pi shennitrakkeka betokah — en bo chashash chimmutz, umedicho umuttar. Apillu im nitbaqqea haddagan — yesh lehattir, kemo shennitbaer besiman ts"b leinyan chitta shennimtzet betok me perot, ayyen sham. Abal mi sheraqaq dam, im metzatzo beshinnayv kederek haroqeqim — hare zeh machmitz, lepi shei epshar lo belo tzichtzuche roq:

Vekevan sheharoq machmitz, lepikak lo yilos adam chittim veyanniach al gabbe makkato, mippene shehen mitchammetzot al yede haroq shebbepiv kesheshshohin al gabbe hammakka shiur mil, veober alehen be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Vaapillu leasan vehinniach al gabbe makkato qodem happesach — tzarik lehasiran keshettaggia shaa shishshit beereb pesach, ella im ken kebar nisrecha ad shennipsela meakilat keleb, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"b:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Bechittim shel yisrael, abal chittim shel nokri shelleasan hannokri vehishilan leyisrael lehannichan al gabbe makkato bepesach — hare zeh muttar im en acharayuto al hayyisrael, kevan sheen dato lizkot bahem sheyyihyeh shello, ella adayin hen birshut hannokri, ulekak eno ober alehem be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze". Veim en lannokri chittim — yakol hayyisrael lehaqnot lo chittim veyilasen hannokri veyashilen lehayyisrael. Veap al pi shehu neheneh umitrappe mechametz bepesach — en bekak kelum, kevan shehu shello kederek hanaato en bo issur ella middibre soperim, ubimqom repua lo gazeru chakamim:

Vekol zeh bemakka sheen bo sakkana, abal im yesh sham chashash sakkana — muttar leyisrael laasot hechametz mishshello lirpua, vehu sheyyihyeh harepua yadua o al pi mumcheh, kemo shennitbaer beyoreh dea siman qn"h. Umi sheyyesh lo choli bebitno (sheqqorin hyy"b mvt"r) sherpuato shemmebashshelin seorin o shibbolet shual umannichin al gabbe bitno, im era choli zeh bepesach veyesh bo sakkana — martichin hammayim heteb veachar kak choletin hasseorin betokan, veshub enan baim lide chimmutz, lepi shekkol mah sheepshar laasot behetter tzarik laasot. Veken im epshar lachlot hasseorim beme perot — lo yachlitem bemayim, shehare haggeonim aseru kol mine chalita bemayim, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"d:

Hannoten seorim lipne behemto bepesach veachar kak matza bahem rir sheyyatza mippi habbehema — tzarik lebaaram shemma kebar hechmitzu. Veap im lo shaha shiur mil, mikkol maqom im lo yebaarem yabou lide chimmutz kesheyyishhu shiur mil veyaabor alehem be"bal yeraeh" u"bal yimmatze", veim toklem behemto — nimtza neheneh mechametz bepesach. Abal min hassetam sheeno yodea im yesh bahem rir im lav — en tzarik lebaaram, sheen machaziqin issur missapeq. Bammeh debarim amurim? Bishar mine behema, chutz min habbaqar, shedderek habbaqar lehotzi rir bishat akila, umin hassetam yesh rir bemah shennishtayyer meakilato, lepikak yesh lizzaher litten lo leekol meat meat beinyan shello yishtayyer kelum meakilato. Veyesh machamirin gam bishar mine behema litten lipnehem meat meat. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem:

Zeat hachoma — dinah kemayim, ki hachoma mezia mikkoach hammayim sheyyesh bah. Veap zeat kotel shel etz — dinah kemayim, ki haetz mazzia mikkoach hammayim sheqqibbel beodo bimchubbar. Veken zeat basar yabesh shemmazzia bimot haggeshamim — dinah kemayim, ki hu mazzia mikkoach hammayim shehudach bahen qodem melichato. Veyesh choleqin al zeh veomerim shezzeat hachoma ubasar yabesh ap shehi baa mikkoach hammayim — en dinah kemayim, ella keme perot. Abal zea mimmayim atzman, kegon zeat hammerchatz shehu mazzia mehebel hammayim chammin shebbetokah — dinah kemayim. Abal im mazzia mechom haur — dinah keme perot. Uleinyan halaka — yesh lehachamir kechumre shette hassebarot leinyan akila bepesach, dehaynu sheyyesh litten al zea zo chumre mayim shehem bilbaddan yekolin lehabi lide chimmutz, vechumre me perot shehem memaharin lehachmitz im taarobet mayim kol shehu yoter mimmayim bilbaddan, veim napelu letok haissa — tzarik leepotah miyyad. Abal leinyan lehashhot ad leachar happesach — yesh lehaqel kequlle b' hassebarot, sheim nopla zea zo bilbaddah al haqqemach — yakol lehashhoto ad leachar happesach. Veken im nopla letok issa shennillosha bemayim velo apaah miyyad — yakol lehashhotah ad leachar happesach:

Im napelu mayim al qemach — yasir meqom hamluchlach vehashshear muttar, apillu napelu hammayim betok happesach. Vetob leraqqedo achar kak. Veken im saq male qemach nitlachleach miqtzato mimmayim — yeechoz beyado et meqom hamluchlach im haqqemach sheetzlo ad sheyyariq kol haqqemach shebbassaq veachar kak yeraqqedennu. Veim i epshar laasot ken, kegon shennitlachleach betziddo beharbeh meqomot — yeraqqed kol haqqemach, vekol qemach shennitlachleach vehaya kemo issa yishshaer lemala, vehashshear muttar apillu hu betok happesach. Veim hu yom tob sheasur leyisrael leraqqed kol haqqemach im en tzarik lekullo beyom tob shehare hu toreach letzorek hachol — yeraqqedennu al yede nokri, dekevan shekkebar nirqad haqqemach paam achat qodem yom tob veyatzeu mimmennu kol hassubbin veeno chozer veroqedo ella kede lebaer hechametz mittoko, im ken en kan melaka gemura ella shebut middibre soperim, kemo sheyyitbaer besiman tq"v, vehaamira lenokri hu shebut dishbut, vehittiruhu letzorek mitzvat biur chametz, shekkeshemmesir qemach hamluchlach mishshear haqqemach umashliko artza hu mitbaer meelayv al yede derisat haraglayim. Veim hu rotzeh yakol hu litten kol haqqemach shebbassaq bemattana gemura lenokri miyyad shennitlachleach qodem sheshshaha shiur mil, veaz lo yitztarek leraqqedo kelal:

Bammeh debarim amurim shemmoil riqqud? Bizman shehaqqemach meluchlach, abal im nityabbesh hallachluchit bimqomot harbeh — en riqqud moil kelum, sheyyesh lachosh al haqqemach shennityabbesh shemma niprak venaasa mimmennu perurin daqqim vehen yotzein derek niqbe hannapa umitorbin bishar haqqemach. Veenan betelim betokah beshishshim, lepi shezzehu domeh letaarobet yabesh belach, shehare haqqemach dino kelach, lepi shehu nimmoach umitpashshet veniblal yapeh, vehapperur ap shehu daq keqemach dino keyabesh, lepi shehu gush echad veeno nimmoach umitpashshet, ulekak eno niblal betok haqqemach ella hu omed sham bipne atzmo, veen zeh niqra taarobet, ulepikak eno mitbattel sham. Veap ledibre haomerim (beyoreh dea siman q"d) shehayyabesh shennitareb belach beinyan shei epshar lehasiro mishsham, kegon perur shennapal letok roteb abeh shei epshar lesannenah, hare hu mitbattel beshishshim, dekevan shei epshar leadam lehaprid happerur meharoteb, ap sheenan niblalin zeh bazeh ella hu omed bipne atzmo betok haroteb, hare zeh niqra taarobet, mikkol maqom qemach zeh sheyyesh perur chametz betoko — i epshar leoklo bepesach ap shennitbattel betoko qodem happesach, lepi shehapperur chozer veneor keshemmaggia happesach, shechametz bemashshehu, sheeno domeh letaarobet lach belach shennitbattel beshishshim qodem happesach sheeno chozer veneor bepesach, lepi shelach belach niblalin zeh bazeh yapeh venaasin gup echad mammash, ulekak en hammitbattel chozer veneor kevan shekkebar naasa gup echad im hambattel, mah sheen ken happerur sheeno niblal betok haqqemach ella hu omed sham beeno — hare hu chozer veneor:

Vaapillu im rotzeh leepot hammatztzot miqqemach zeh qodem happesach, venimtza shennaasu happerurin im haqqemach gup echad mammash al yede haapiyya qodem happesach, veshub en chozer veneor betok happesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tn"g, mikkol maqom yesh lachosh lehaomerim sheyyabesh belach eno mitbattel kelal, veim ken happerur shehu yabesh nuqsheh eno mitbattel baqqemach ap leachar hallisha vehaapiyya, shehare en beissat hammatztza perurin yebeshim sheyyitbattelu perure hechametz betokam berob kedin taarobet yabesh beyabesh. Veyesh choleqin umattirin im rotzeh leepot matztzot miqqemach zeh qodem happesach, shekkebar naasu ellu happerurin gup echad venitbattelu qodem happesach veshub eno chozer veneor, sheeno domeh letaarobet yabesh belach, meachar shehapperur hu naaseh daq keqemach, ella shechosheshin lehaomerim deqemach shennitareb beqemach yesh lo din yabesh beyabesh shechozer veneor bepesach, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z sheyyesh omerim ken, ulepikak im apa qodem pesach — muttar ledibre hakkol. Veyesh lismok al dibrehem bishat haddechaq sheeno matzuy liqnot qemach acher o litchon chittim acherim. Umikkol maqom, yesh lehachamir littol mehaqqemach veleekol qodem happesach, kede litlot happerurin bemah sheakal kebar, ayyen siman tk"t:

Umikkol maqom, ledibre hakkol muttar lehashhot haqqemach leachar sheriqqedo ad leachar happesach, shehare ap lehaomerim shettaarobet lach belach shennitbattel beshishshim qodem happesach chozer veneor bepesach veasur leoklo, ap al pi ken muttar lehashhoto, kemo shennitbaer besiman tm"z. Veap sheyyesh lehachamir kehaomerim sheyyabesh belach eno mitbattel, veim ken perurin shebbetok haqqemach lo nitbattel meolam, vehaya rauy leesor lehashhot haqqemach bepesach shehapperurim hem betoko, mikkol maqom kevan sheissur shehiyya zo enah ella middibre soperim (shehare en sham perur kezayit), vegam en kan chametz vadday ella sapeq shemma yatza perur derek niqbe hannapa, lekak yesh lismok al haomerim sheyyabesh belach mitbattel, ukebar nitbattelu happerurim betok haqqemach qodem happesach, ulepikak muttar lehashhoto:

Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennityabbesh lachluchit haqqemach qodem happesach ap sheriqqedo betok happesach, abal im nityabbesh bepesach — asur lehashhoto ap leachar sheyyeraqqedennu, sheyyesh lachosh shemma nitparer letoko perurim daqqim, vahare naasa taarobet zeh betok happesach, shehare qodem happesach adayin lo nityabbesh hallachluchit, vehaya az kemo issa velo haya meorab kelal bishar haqqemach:

Vekol zeh keshennityabbesh hallachluchit bimqomot harbeh, abal im nityabbesh bemaqom echad mitztzidde hassaq, apillu nityabbesh betok happesach — yeechoz beyado et hammaqom shennitlachleach venityabbesh bassaq im haqqemach sheetzlo ad sheyyoriq kol haqqemach shebbassaq, veachar kak yeraqqedennu. Veim lo riqqedo — hare zeh muttar, kevan shekkebar hesir et hammaqom shennapelu alayv mayim:

Vekol zeh kesheyyadua shennitlachleach mimmayim, abal im yesh lehistappeq shemma beme perot sheenan mebiin lide chimmutz — yesh lehattir al yede riqqud apillu baakila, ap im nityabbesh hallachluchit betok happesach, ki yesh kan sepeq sepeqa: shemma nitlachleach beme perot sheenan mebiin lide chimmutz, veim timtza lomar mimmayim, shemma lo nitareb kelum behaqqemach millachluchit shennityabbesh letok shear haqqemach. Umikkol maqom, im epshar lo beqal limtzo qemach acher lepesach — en lismok al hassepeq sepeqa leekol qemach zeh bepesach, ella yatzniennu leachar happesach:

Saq male qemach shennasheku bo haakbarim, apillu roeh lachluchit al haqqemach bammaqom hannashuk shennitlachleach meroq shebbepi haakbar, vaapillu nityabbesh hallachluchit betok happesach — yeechoz beyado et meqom hannashuk bassaq im haqqemach sheetzlo veyiqshor sham ad sheyyariq kol haqqemach shebbassaq, veachar kak yeraqqedennu. Veen chosheshim shemma haleku haakbarim bekol haqqemach shebbassaq veakelu sham venitchammetz meharir sheyyatza mippihem, lepi sheap im akelu sham haddabar qarob levadday shello yatza rir mippihem, sheen derek haakbar lehotzi rir mippiv bishat akilato. Abal haqqemach shebbammaqom hannashuk — yesh leosro apillu eno roeh alayv velo al hassaq shum lachluchit. Veim niana et hassaq ad shehaqqemach shebbammaqom hannashuk nitareb bishar haqqemach shebbassaq, im hu qodem happesach — yeraqqed kol haqqemach veyashhenna ad leachar happesach. Veim hu betok happesach — asur lehashhoto. Bammeh debarim amurim? Keshennireh laayin sheakal haakbar qetzat min haqqemach shebbammaqom hannashuk, abal im nashak raq hassaq veyesh lehistappeq shemma lo akal kelum min haqqemach — muttar lehashhoto apillu nashak hassaq veniana oto betok happesach. Veen tzarik leraqqedo kelal, kevan shello nolad reuta baqqemach atzmo ella bassaq. Abal en leoklo bepesach apillu al yede riqqud im niana et hassaq, apillu niana oto qodem happesach (ki haqqemach shebbammaqom hannashuk yesh bo chashash chimmutz gamur, shehaddabar qarob levadday sheal yede dochaq neshikat haakbar bassaq yatza roq mippiv al yede dochaq hanneshika, veepshar shennapal al haqqemach sheetzlo venitchammetz):

Qemach shennapal alayv delep hayyored min haggag apillu kol hayyom kullo — eno ba lide chimmutz, shettirdat haddelep monea millehachmitz et haqqemach hashsharuy beme haddelep. Vehu shehaya haddelep tored tippa achar tippa miyyad beli hepseq kelal benetayim. Veim hu mesuppaq im haddelep tored im lav — asur apillu lehashhotan, mippene shehu sapeq shel tora, ukesheyyipsoq tirdat haddelep — tzarik lelusho miyyad veleepoto, veim shaha shiur mil — hare zeh asur. Veken dagan shehaddelep tored alayv apillu kol hayyom kullo eno ba lide chimmutz, ukesheyyipsoq tirdat haddelep — tzarik letochono miyyad:
